description: Self-hosted, open-source client document collection portal with passwordless magic links, deterministic tax and bank ID checksum validation, per-record AES-256-GCM encryption, keyboard-first review, signed webhooks, and a metadata-only MCP 2.0 server.
name: GatherGate
seoDescription: Self-hosted magic-link client document intake portal with deterministic validation and AES-256-GCM encryption. Deploy GatherGate with Docker Compose on Dokploy.
